about: A chip of BN5's whose code moved into BN6's engine (issue #82's C3): BN5's CanladEX held paralysed (hold: each game's own status step, the same bits in both) at (5,2), MegaMan at (2,2) with a folder of LavaSeed H in both games, BN5's chip 43 by BN5's own code and the registry's 426 by the same code moved (BN5's bomb family 0x12 as BN6's 0x62), the first Custom screen's chip picked and OK, used at t30, its seed's lava (BN5's type 8 as BN6's 13, xpanels.c's): every difference of BN6's play from BN5's fails it (docs/multirom/chips-code.md).
